audit.whatIsWrong: Levels 1-5 were shipped as Skill/Tryndamere/Tryndamere/Skill while their own whys say Warwick wins the level-1 trade, stays ahead at 2, keeps 3 on Q lifesteal and holds 4. Two phase whys also claimed 'your core pattern starts now' on stages Warwick owns.
audit.why: packet.levelChart is [Warwick, Warwick, Warwick, Warwick, Skill, Tryndamere, Tryndamere], the whys agree, and Tryndamere is at 48.04% over 997 games — an early-losing lane he wins back with items.
audit.corrected: Rows 0-3 flipped to Warwick in both layers with ratings, level 6 left as Skill (already correct), and phases[1].why / phases[2].why rewritten to state why he holds those levels.

audit.why: Warwick's spike is his early sustain curve, yours is the first crit item and 2 items; level 6 is the neutral reset because Undying Rage's 5 seconds outlast a 1.5-second suppression.

audit.whatIsWrong: No cooldown or duration appeared for Infinite Duress, the anti-heal timing was never tied to Jaws of the Beast, the passive's tripled healing under 25% HP was missing, and nothing warned that Q is max-health damage.
audit.why: Riot kit: Infinite Duress suppresses 1.5s on a 110/90/70s cooldown; Jaws of the Beast is 8/7.5/7/6.5/6s and heals for damage dealt; Eternal Hunger heals him below 50% HP and triples that below 25%; Jaws of the Beast deals damage based on target maximum health, so armour stacking is the wrong answer.
audit.corrected: Rewrote dosFull[0].d, dosFull[1].d, dontsFull[0].d and dontsFull[1].d with those numbers and the max-health warning.
